record.input_law: One public point supplied directly; its validation-only scalar is not sent to IC and is used only for independent post-run replay.
record.online_cache_state: Target-independent base, support index, and factor logs ready; this is the first and only query in the process.
record.resource_policy: No finite process memory cap; run both arms sequentially on the same host and record each peak RSS.
record.target_generation: Completed before the measurement and excluded from both online intervals.
